description: This file defines a Orleans grain class 'StatelessWorkerScalingGrain' with shared state management for activation and waiting counts, including methods for synchronization and status retrieval, specifically for testing or scaling scenarios.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrainSharedState
classes.description: Holds shared synchronization primitives and counters for activation and waiting states across grain instances.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing a stateless worker with scaling and synchronization capabilities for testing purposes.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Asynchronously waits on a semaphore, updating waiting count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the semaphore to allow waiting grains to proceed.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current activation count for this grain instance.

methods.name: GetWaitingCount
methods.description: Returns the current waiting count for this grain instance.
